theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (y : Euclid P), (∀ x : Euclid P, f (y + x) = f x) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f A
